title: Custom Anthropic-compatible provider: schema, resolver, client, settings action
interface: Core of the feature, test-first (write tests/custom-ai-provider.test.ts and the new resolver/public-settings cases first, see them fail, then implement). (1) Migration 033_custom_ai_provider.sql: add the four ai_settings columns (IF NOT EXISTS); drop and re-add ai_settings_ai_provider_check, lf_campaigns_ai_provider_check and lf_llm_costs_provider_check with 'custom' added to their existing value lists (read supabase/migrations/027_lead_finder_parity.sql for the current lists and constraint definitions); column grants following 030_followup.sql: authenticated may SELECT custom_base_url, custom_model, custom_fast_model but NOT custom_api_key; UPDATE/INSERT grants on all four to match how 030 treats the other secret columns. Idempotent, wrapped in a transaction. (2) types/database.ts ai_settings Row/Insert/Update and lib/ai/types.ts (AISettings fields, custom_api_key in AI_SETTINGS_SECRET_COLUMNS, has_custom_api_key on PublicAISettings). (3) lib/ai/public-settings.ts: strip custom_api_key and set has_custom_api_key; add custom_base_url, custom_model, custom_fast_model, custom_api_key to AI_SETTINGS_WRITABLE_COLUMNS. (4) lib/ai/custom-provider.ts per the contract. (5) lib/ai/provider-resolver.ts: 'custom' in ResolvedAIProviderName and AI_PROVIDER_ORDER (last), custom_* in AIProviderSettings, orgCredential custom decrypts via openCustomApiKey, envCredential custom returns null. (6) lib/ai/models.ts: getModelId(model, provider, settings?) and convertModelForProvider handle 'custom' by returning customModelFor(tier, settings) (tier: 'haiku' when the requested alias/id is haiku, else 'sonnet'); keep existing behaviour for other providers; update callers inside lib/ai/client.ts accordingly. (7) lib/ai/client.ts: createAIMessagesClient case 'custom' builds new Anthropic({ apiKey, baseURL: anthropicSdkBaseUrl(base), fetch: pinned.fetch }) with a fresh createCustomFetch per call and close() after the call completes (wrap messages.create); getAIClient/getProviderChain/callAIWithFallback carry custom settings so model conversion yields the custom model for the custom provider and Claude ids for anthropic. (8) lib/actions/ai-settings.ts updateAISettings: when custom_base_url is present, normalizeCustomBaseUrl then assertSafeFetchTarget (reject with a clear error); when custom_api_key is present (non-blank), seal it with encrypt() before writing; ai_provider may be set to 'custom'. Add a server action listCustomModels(input?: { baseUrl?: string; apiKey?: string }) that uses the saved settings when args are omitted (admin/owner only via requireRole like updateAISettings), calls GET {base}/v1/models through createCustomFetch with headers x-api-key and anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, 10s timeout, returns { ok: true, models: string[] } (ids from data[].id) or { ok: false, error } with a user-readable message and never echoes the key. (9) lib/actions/ai-lead-validation.ts: replace the hardcoded claude ids at about L54/L140 with getModelId(tier, provider, settings) so it works for every provider. Tests: normalizeCustomBaseUrl cases (https required, strips /v1 and slashes, rejects http, userinfo, query), customModelFor fallback, openCustomApiKey round trip with a test ENCRYPTION_KEY set in the test, resolver: custom needs url+key, never uses env, explicit choice, order last; public settings: key stripped and flag set, writable columns include the four; createCustomFetch rejects a private/loopback base (inject a lookup if assertSafeFetchTarget supports one, see tests/ssrf-guard.test.ts for the pattern). CONTRACT (shared by C1-C3). A new AI provider value 'custom' means an org-configured Anthropic-compatible endpoint (e.g. LLMsRelay: base https://api.llmsrelay.com, keys sk-cs4-..., models like claude-sonnet-4.6 / claude-haiku-4.5 listed by GET {base}/v1/models, auth header x-api-key plus anthropic-version). ai_settings gains: custom_base_url text (the endpoint origin plus optional path, stored WITHOUT a trailing /v1), custom_api_key text (stored SEALED with encrypt() from lib/utils/encryption.ts, never plaintext), custom_model text (used for the sonnet tier and as default), custom_fast_model text (optional, used for the haiku tier; falls back to custom_model). Helpers exported from a new plain module lib/ai/custom-provider.ts: normalizeCustomBaseUrl(input: string): string (trim, require https: scheme, strip trailing slashes and a trailing /v1, reject credentials/query/fragment; throws Error with a user-readable message), anthropicSdkBaseUrl(base) = base (the @anthropic-ai/sdk appends /v1/messages), aiSdkBaseUrl(base) = base + '/v1' (the @ai-sdk/anthropic provider expects the /v1 base), customModelFor(tier: 'sonnet' | 'haiku', s: {custom_model?: string | null; custom_fast_model?: string | null}): string | null, openCustomApiKey(sealed: string | null | undefined): string | null (decrypt; legacy plaintext passes through like openChannelToken in lib/utils/channel-token.ts; tampered returns null), and async createCustomFetch(base: string): Promise<{ fetch: typeof fetch; close: () => void }> which runs assertSafeFetchTarget (lib/security/fetch-target.ts) on the base URL and returns createPinnedFetch (lib/security/safe-fetch.ts) so every request is pinned to the validated public IPs (DNS-rebinding safe). resolveAIProvider returns for 'custom' { provider: 'custom', apiKey, baseURL } only when both custom_base_url and a decryptable key exist; 'custom' has NO env fallback (never send the server ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or any env key to a tenant URL); 'custom' is appended at the END of AI_PROVIDER_ORDER. Fallback chains (callAIWithFallback) must never pass one provider's key to another provider's URL. Rules: Windows + Git Bash, no ripgrep (use grep). Touch only the listed files (a new file in the list may be created). Keep each file's line endings. Never write real secrets anywhere; tests use fake keys like sk-cs4-test. Do not run git add/commit and do not touch any database or the browser. Run npx tsc --noEmit, eslint on your files, npm test (vitest) and the verify greps before reporting.

title: Security review fixes for the custom provider
interface: Security review fixes for the custom Anthropic-compatible provider (commits 04bbadd, faee201, d2ab26f). Migration 033 has NOT been applied to any database yet, so edit it in place. Work test-first for the testable parts. (1) CRITICAL, migration 033: remove the GRANT UPDATE and GRANT INSERT on custom_base_url, custom_api_key, custom_model, custom_fast_model to authenticated (keep only GRANT SELECT on custom_base_url, custom_model, custom_fast_model); add explicit REVOKE UPDATE and REVOKE INSERT on those four columns FROM authenticated so a re-run is safe; comment why (only updateAISettings writes them, through the admin client). (2) CRITICAL, lib/utils/encryption.ts: encrypt(plain, aad?) and decrypt(sealed, aad?) accept optional additional authenticated data (cipher.setAAD and decipher.setAAD with Buffer.from(aad, 'utf8')) without changing the output format or behaviour when aad is omitted (all existing callers unchanged); createDecipheriv with { authTagLength: 16 }. (3) CRITICAL, lib/ai/custom-provider.ts: export customKeyAad(orgId, normalizedBaseUrl) returning custom_ai_key:v1:<orgId>:<normalizedBaseUrl>; export sealCustomApiKey(plain, orgId, baseUrl) that normalizes the URL and encrypts with that AAD; openCustomApiKey(sealed, orgId, baseUrl) decrypts only sealed values with that AAD and returns null for plaintext, tampered, wrong org or a different URL (no legacy plaintext pass-through). createCustomFetch(base, lookup?) also returns base (the normalized URL) and callers use it for the SDK baseURL. lib/ai/provider-resolver.ts: AIProviderSettings gains organization_id so orgCredential custom can call openCustomApiKey(custom_api_key, organization_id, custom_base_url); keep all resolver tests passing and add one for the org binding. Update every caller (lib/ai/client.ts getAIClient, app/api/ai/chat/route.ts select, lib/lead-finder/ai-provider.ts, lib/actions/ai-settings.ts) to pass the org id. (4) MEDIUM, lib/actions/ai-settings.ts: updateAISettings seals custom_api_key with sealCustomApiKey(key, orgId, normalizedUrl); if custom_base_url changes (normalized compare with the saved one) and no new key is supplied, reject with the message: Re-enter the API key when changing the base URL. If the URL is unchanged and the key is blank keep the saved key. listCustomModels uses the saved key only when the normalized typed URL equals the normalized saved URL, otherwise it requires a typed key (message: Enter the API key for this URL); rate-limit listCustomModels per org (reuse lib/ai/rate-limiter.ts if it fits, else a small in-memory window of 10 calls per minute per org); reject base URLs with an explicit port other than 443 (do this in normalizeCustomBaseUrl so every path gets it). (5) MEDIUM, lib/ai/client.ts and lib/lead-finder/ai-provider.ts: new Anthropic({ apiKey, authToken: null, baseURL: pinned.base, fetch: pinned.fetch, timeout: 60_000, maxRetries: 1 }). app/api/ai/chat/route.ts custom branch: an explicit if (!resolved.apiKey) return notConfigured(); use pinned.base for aiSdkBaseUrl. (6) LOW, chat route: pass abortSignal: req.signal to streamText and add onAbort that releases the rate-limit slot and closes the custom fetch (idempotent with the existing guards). (7) LOW, lib/security/safe-fetch.ts pinned fetch: also require url.protocol === target.url.protocol. Tests: tests/encryption-aad.test.ts (AAD round trip, wrong AAD fails, decrypt without AAD unchanged for values sealed without AAD); tests/custom-ai-provider.test.ts (openCustomApiKey rejects plaintext, other org, other URL; seal/open round trip; port other than 443 rejected); tests/safe-fetch.test.ts (protocol mismatch rejected). Rules: Windows + Git Bash, no ripgrep (use grep); touch only the listed files (tests/encryption-aad.test.ts is new); keep line endings; fake keys only; no git add or commit, no database, no browser.
